page.content:
Movement of monks, texts, and images from India into China via Central Asia.

How Buddhism transmission connects

  • Faction: Kushan Empire — Kushan patronage carried Buddhism toward the Tarim and China.
  • Location: Mogao Caves — The Mogao Caves are a monumental archive of transmitted Buddhism.
  • Location: Dunhuang — Dunhuang's caves record Buddhism's long halt on the eastern road.
  • Location: Chang'an — Chang'an became a translation capital for incoming sutras.

What is Buddhism transmission?

Buddhism's transmission along the Silk Road is a centuries-long event: Kushan patronage, Dunhuang caves, and translators in Chang'an who made Indian sutras into Chinese religion.

Key threads lead to Kushan Empire, Mogao Caves, Dunhuang and Chang'an.
